## Query

| | |
|---|---|
| Dataset | `bluelink-daily-temp` ([forms](../../published.md)) |
| Selection | `temp.isel(Time=-1, xt_ocean=1200, yt_ocean=slice(300, 350), st_ocean=5)` |
| Coordinates | 2026-07-31T12:00, 120.05 E, 44.95 S to 40.05 S, 28.17 m |
| Result | 50 values, float64; first `8.91857684`, last `11.86025596` |

One source chunk: rows 300-349 and column 1200 all fall in the 300 x 300
chunk starting at (300, 1200) of one day and one depth.

## Readers

::: {.panel-tabset}

## gdalxarray, mdim VRT

[ok]{.status .status-ok} Michael, 2026-11-02

```python
import xarray
ds = xarray.open_dataset(
    "/vsicurl/https://data.source.coop/ausantarctic/ausantarctic-scratch/"
    "virtual/bluelink-daily-temp/mdim.vrt",
    engine="gdalxarray")
ds.temp.isel(Time=-1, xt_ocean=1200, yt_ocean=slice(300, 350), st_ocean=5).values
```

## gdalxarray, kerchunk

[ok]{.status .status-ok} Michael, 2026-11-02;
values identical to the VRT tab

```python
import xarray
ds = xarray.open_dataset(
    'ZARR:"/vsicurl/https://data.source.coop/ausantarctic/ausantarctic-scratch/'
    'virtual/bluelink-daily-temp/kerchunk/"',
    engine="gdalxarray")
ds.temp.isel(Time=-1, xt_ocean=1200, yt_ocean=slice(300, 350), st_ocean=5).values
```

## gdalxarray, Icechunk

[no]{.status .status-no} Michael, Pawsey (gdal-r-python_dev SIF, older build), 2026-11-02

```python
import xarray
ds = xarray.open_dataset(
    "/vsiicechunk/{/vsicurl/https://data.source.coop/ausantarctic/"
    "ausantarctic-scratch/virtual/bluelink-daily-temp/icechunk}",
    engine="gdalxarray")
# Skipping array 'temp': //temp: Unsupported codec: numcodecs.shuffle
```

Coordinates open; `temp` is skipped. GDAL's Zarr v3 reader has no
`numcodecs.shuffle` (GDAL master, 2026-11-01). See [Readers](../../readers.qmd).

## icechunk + xarray

[not run]{.status .status-todo} for this selection; the open is checked in
[the salinity example](../bluelink-salt-point-profile-series/index.qmd).

```python
import icechunk as ic, xarray as xr, zarr
storage = ic.s3_storage(bucket="us-west-2.opendata.source.coop",
                        prefix="ausantarctic/ausantarctic-scratch/virtual/bluelink-daily-temp/icechunk",
                        region="us-west-2", anonymous=True)
repo = ic.Repository.open(storage, authorize_virtual_chunk_access={
    "https://thredds.nci.org.au/": ic.credentials.HttpAccess})
zarr.config.set({"async.concurrency": 4})
ds = xr.open_zarr(repo.readonly_session("main").store, consolidated=False, chunks=None)
ds.temp.isel(Time=-1, xt_ocean=1200, yt_ocean=slice(300, 350), st_ocean=5).values
```
